captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a sleek, simplified model rocket. It features a tall, cylindrical fuselage topped with an elongated, parabolic nose cone. At the base, four triangular fins are arranged symmetrically at 90-degree intervals to provide aerodynamic stability.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable model rocket with adjustable parameters for the body height, body diameter, wing scale, and overall model scale. The rocket should feature a cylindrical body, an elongated nose cone, and four triangular fins evenly spaced around the base.
captions.factory: The rocket is built using a union of three main components: a cylinder for the body, a scaled sphere translated to the top of the cylinder for the nose cone, and four triangular fins created using linear_extrude on a 2D polygon. A for-loop rotates each fin by 90-degree increments around the z-axis. The entire assembly is scaled according to a global scale parameter, and a difference operation with a large lower cylinder is used to clean up any downward-protruding geometries.
